title: Quit Minigame
description: A small mod that disables the quit button unless you press the confirm button. Perfect if you often break your redstone
body:
A simple mod that adds a checkbox to in-world main menu and disables the disconnect/quit button. Unlocking the button when the checkbox is ticked. The checkbox is randomly placed around the menu making sure you truly think about it before disconnecting. 

Ideal for those who often leave their world with their Redstone contraptions running and breaking them
